text:
Erin C (Finance): FYI partner Resellify found a pricing mismatch on our GCP Marketplace invoice for May. They claim list vs. billed price divergence for sku `redwood-pro` across 2026-05-08 to 2026-05-10 totaling $9,860.

Rosa V (Sales): We changed the tier pricing on 2026-05-07 (discount rule RWD-PR-21). I flagged this for marketplace team but not sure the channel propagation succeeded. Partner sent a CSV sample.

Liam B (Billing Ops): Can you paste the sample lines? Need to confirm whether meter usage was billed at old price and new price simultaneously.

Rosa V (Sales): Sample:```
invoice_line,sku,usage_unit,price_per_unit,charge
GCP-4411,redwood-pro,1000,0.095,95.00
GCP-4412,redwood-pro,1000,0.185,185.00
```
They say duplicates reflect different price tiers applied to same usage window.

BillingBot: GCP payout for Resellify (partner_id RF-42) scheduled 2026-05-20T03:00:00Z, status pending.

Erin C (Finance): Proposed: freeze payout, request partner acceptance for a one-time correction, and issue credit $9,860. Need legal sign-off on amendment language.

Sofia (Legal): Draft clause: "Partner accepts a one-time reconciliation for the billing period May 8–10, 2026, limited to the identified pricing propagation error. Acceptance constitutes final settlement for those charges." Will send for e-sign.

Liam B (Billing Ops): If partner signs, GL entry: Debit Revenue 4205-REV-CR / Credit AP-Partner 2202. I'll hold until signed.

Rosa V (Sales): Sent amendment at 2026-05-18T08:22Z. Partner signed at 2026-05-18T12:10Z and uploaded confirmation.

Liam B (Billing Ops): Applying manual credit now. Memo GCP-MP-2026-05-PRICING-ADJ. Reducing scheduled payout by $9,860. Posting to ledger.

Erin C (Finance): Confirmed posting. Marking as resolved and adding a checklist item: verify price rule propagation to channel APIs in rollout playbook.

BillingBot: Payout updated; hold released. No further actions pending.

Rosa V (Sales): Partner acknowledged the adjustment. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
